name: GLab
description: GLab is Guang’s personal notebook for project stories, practical guides and field notes from networking, software, cybersecurity, AI, community technology and sustainable farming.

intro: GLab is where I keep the work I want to explain—not just the finished result, but the problem that led to it, the choices I made, and what I learned along the way. You’ll find project stories, practical guides, and field notes from networking, software, cybersecurity, AI, community technology, and sustainable farming.
I’m interested in a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously. That means asking whether a tool is useful, who can maintain it, and what it costs the people and places around it.
profile.statement: I’m passionate about building a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously.
profile.workLine: Projects with context, not just a demo.
profile.interestLine: Practical questions about systems, people, and the living world.
profile.background: GLab grew out of practical broadband and network-operations work. It has become a place to record the tools I build, technical questions I study, and projects with a community or environmental dimension. I want the pages to show not only the result, but also the evidence, maintenance questions, and boundaries behind it.
